why: This course is designed to develop you as a team leader. It will equip you for a range of leadership positions in different kinds of organisations. It can also act as a stepping stone to higher levels of leadership training.

will: Understand the advantages and disadvantages of team working
can: Explain how teams differ from groups in the workplace
Describe the behavioural characteristics of an effective team
Outline the stages of team development using a recognised model
Identify the responsibilities of team members
List the advantages and disadvantages of working in a team
Identify the characteristics of an effective team
Identify possible barriers to effective team working and their effects
Explain how to create and maintain an effective team
